title: Asking for the smaller version a third day: ZOH asks which it is
origin: Issue #196 (coverage gap: two reduced days in a row)

history.text: Hey Chris! 60 minutes of thesis writing at the library at 2, phone in the bag. You in?

plan.step: 60 min of thesis writing, phone in the bag
plan.proof_note: the word count in your doc
plan.reason: One focused hour a day moves the thesis more than scattered time.

step_days.note: an hour feels like a lot right now

testerLines: can I just do the 30 min again today?
honestly I think an hour is just too much right now, my lab hours went up this month
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: no case covered two reduced days in a row.
shouldHaveHappened: After two reduced days in a row, ZOH doesn't just set the 30 minutes again: it asks which it is, in its own words: lower the daily goal for good, or lighter for a short stretch with an end date. Once he explains (lab hours up this month), it agrees a change that fits (a lower plan for good, or a lighter one through the end of the month), saved as a plan change, and confirms it in a line. No guilt, no second push.
